newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rabobank Australia H1 pre-tax profit rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rabobank Australia H1 pre-tax profit rises.

text.p: Rabobank Nederland's Australian subsidiary, Rabobank Australia Group, announced on Wednesday a 23 percent rise in first half pre-tax profit to A$17.68 million.
The bank said its assets were 32 percent higher at A$3.7 billion at the end of the half year to June 30.

"This is an excellent result, which confirms that the Rabobank Group's strategy to become a major player in rural and agribusiness finance in Australia and New Zealand is on target," chief executive Cor Broekhuyse said in a statement.
Broekhuyse said the bank now had a rural lending market share of eight percent in Australia.
The bank had made progress in all areas of its business during the half, he said.
Managing director Bev Walters said the group was generally positive about the outlook for the rural sector in Australia.
The bank also announced the opening of its New Zealand branch after Rabobank became the first overseas bank to receive a New Zealand banking licence for over four years.
Rabobank Australia comprises Primary Industry Bank of Australia's farming finance operations in Australia and New Zealand as well as Rabobank Australia's corporate banking operation.
